per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null
Name must not be null
Name must be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
ID_No must not be null
ID_No must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter
ID_No must not contain placeholder sentinel values
Race must not be null
Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
Gender must not be null
Gender must be one of: Male, Female
Age must not be null
Age must be numeric parseable
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
Contact_No must not be null
Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number: +65 prefix, 8 digits, starting with 6, 8, or 9
Email must not be null
Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
Country must not be null
Country must be 'Singapore'
Street_Name must not be null
Street_Name must be in Title Case
Postal_Code must not be null
Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits (Singapore standard)
Name particles indicating gender must match Gender column: Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female
Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
ID_No must match ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one join key)
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Account_No must be a 4-digit code
Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
